content: संमूढ {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Stupefied, unconscious, senseless. .²2 Infatuated, foolish; स्थिरबुद्धिरसंमूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः <ls>Bg. 5. 20</ls>. .²3 Bewildered; पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः <ls>Bg. 2. 7</ls>. .²4 Disordered. .²5 Heaped, collected. .²6 Produced rapidly. .²7 Broken. .{@-ढा@} A kind of riddle.
